lines.en: I hover low across the ground
My huge skull casts a wide shadow
I float half a block up

lines.zh: 我飘过来，头骨缓缓对准你。
lines.en: I drift closer, my skull slowly turning to face you.
My jaw hangs low
I drift over broken stone
My sockets sweep the ground
I drift around a stone pillar
My jaw hangs half open
I sweep slowly across the arena

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，骨节一动不动。
lines.en: I hang in the air without moving a single joint.

lines.zh: 我的骨头比我的人还大
lines.en: My frame is larger than any body
The fire in my sockets turns slowly
I hear my own bones echo
I count how long this moment lasts
No flesh to tire, so I never do
My great skull tips downward

lines.zh: 我悬在夜色里，等你自己抬头。
lines.en: I hang in the night, waiting for you to look up.
The wind passes through my teeth
I lift my jaw a little
A dull knock comes from my joints
My whole frame just hangs there
I listen for a summons far off
My shadow does not stir
I close my teeth slowly
I wait for the night to deepen
I lower my huge skull at you
You stand between my sockets
You are smaller than my teeth
My jaw opens slowly
You are still standing

lines.zh: 我歪过巨大的头骨，打量你。
lines.en: I tilt my huge skull to size you up.
My shadow covers all of you
You should not be standing here

lines.zh: 你这身皮肉，我早看清了。
lines.en: I have already seen through all that flesh of yours.
What you hold is not enough

lines.zh: 我空空的眼窝一直对着你。
lines.en: My hollow sockets stay fixed on you.
No sound comes from between my teeth
My skull rocks aside
A few bone flakes fall
I drift back into line
That one had some heft
My jaw closes out of line
I re-aim at you
No flesh, no pain.

lines.zh: 这口气我记在颅骨里了。
lines.en: I have stored this grudge in my skull.
My bones are still ringing
This is far from over
I have no stomach to fill
Raise it to the sky, I still will not eat
I do not even have a stomach. Put it away.
It would fall through my frame
I look at it unmoved

lines.zh: 那点食物对骷髅毫无意义。
lines.en: That morsel means nothing to a skeleton.
I am after something else
That will not buy you a night
My mouth is quite empty
Keep it for yourself
You strike my jaw

lines.zh: 我被你撞得偏了半尺，又转回来。
lines.en: Your hit knocks me half a foot aside; I turn back.
You are the one thrown far
My frame does not retreat
That did not even leave a mark
My teeth clack together
I drift slowly back into line
Hitting me is hitting a wall
My teeth ring together

lines.zh: 我的头骨比看起来更沉
lines.en: My skull is heavier than it looks

lines.zh: 我这样的早已不算活物
lines.en: What I am no longer counts as living

lines.zh: 骨头陪着骨头也没意思
lines.en: Bone beside bone means nothing
Holding this one night is enough
Those in the earth have all fallen apart
I cannot answer that
I have not thought of it

lines.zh: 我没有那种念头，把头转开。
lines.en: I have no such notion, and turn my head away.
My teeth close
Such words are for the living
All I have left is this frame

lines.zh: 我俯下头骨，盯着掌里的小东西。
lines.en: I lower my skull and stare at the little thing in my hand.
It is far smaller than my teeth
I nudge it with my jaw
It rolls out of my shadow

lines.zh: 我拿不起这么小的东西
lines.en: I cannot pick up anything so small
I trap it under a bone
This is of no use to me
I raise my head again
I stare at it a long while
It rests beneath my teeth
You stand in my arena
I square my great skull
The night is deep enough
My sockets have kindled
I accept this fight

lines.zh: 你终于抬头，正好对上我的眼窝。
lines.en: You finally look up, straight into my empty sockets.
I need no command

lines.zh: 这一片都在我的影子里
lines.en: All of this lies in my shadow
My skull moves first
You will not leave this circle
I bear down toward you
My bones begin to sound
I have waited long for this night

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the white mist of your breath.
I raise my whole frame
You stand exactly right
I do not cry out, I simply come
You left your retreat behind you
I draw my shadow onto you
You are under me now
I press slowly downward
You ran left just now
My skull stays aimed at you
My shadow draws in
You are hunting a gap in me
I have no gap to give you
I open my jaw again

lines.zh: 你背后是石堆，再退就没路了。
lines.en: The stone pile is at your back; there is nowhere left to go.
I wheel above the arena
I see your every motion
I wait for your strength to go
My teeth are chattering

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我逼得越近。
lines.en: The harder you pant, the closer I press.
I stay above you throughout

lines.zh: 这里空荡荡的，你无处可藏。
lines.en: This place is wide open; there is nowhere for you to hide.
I settle a little lower

lines.zh: 你踩碎枯枝的声音出卖了你。
lines.en: The snap of twigs under your feet gives you away.
I can hear exactly where you are
Turning faster will not help
I tilt my skull lower
My great skull slams down
My jaw clamps on you
My teeth rake your shoulder

lines.zh: 我把整颗头骨砸向你的胸口。
lines.en: I drive my whole skull into your chest.
My skull knocks you back
My bone spur jabs you
That carried all my frame
The blow drops you to a knee
I lift and come down again

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡了一下就裂
lines.en: Your armor holds, then splits
I bite and hold
I draw back half a block and press again
My jaw shuts with a crack
You are flung to the arena's edge
The night air thickens first
My frame gathers out of the dark above
Two sockets light first
A great skull descends out of the shadow
My shadow covers the ground
The wind turns around my skull

lines.zh: 我落定的时候地响了一下
lines.en: The ground sounds once as I settle
The echo of the summoning still hangs
I open my jaw
Bone joins bone

lines.zh: 穹顶在我头顶变得很低
lines.en: The sky feels low above me
I bring my whole frame upright
It is quiet enough to hear my bones
I come to a halt in the air
This whole stretch of dark is mine
My whole frame turns to you
My teeth catch a dim light
The wind comes down with me
My shadow lands at your feet
I am here, wait no longer
Fire cannot burn into bone

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来震了一震
lines.en: Crashing down shakes me once

lines.zh: 水灌进我的空腔，沉得很
lines.en: Water fills my hollows and weighs me down
The blast knocks my jaw askew
An arrow lodges in my seams

lines.zh: 咒光让我的骨架嗡嗡响
lines.en: Magic sets my frame humming
Hunger left me ages ago

lines.zh: 雷电穿过我的整副骨架
lines.en: Lightning runs through my whole frame

lines.zh: 坠落时我的骨头都散了
lines.en: My bones scatter as I fall
